title: This tour covers many of...
text: This tour covers many of the old neighborhoods adjacent to the Alhambra and the guide was very knowledgeable about the city and its history. The sunset views of the old city and the Alhambra were spectacular.
author: James_C

title: This was a great way to...
text: This was a great way to see some of the original residential neighbourhoods of Granada at a lovely time of day with beautiful views of the lit up Alhambra above us. Our guide, Pamela, was extremely knowledgeable.
author: Nadine_P

title: An Uphill walk for marvelous views
text: This is a great way to start your stay in Granada. The walk is challenging as it is uphill. The neighborhoods and views are amazing. Our guide Alex was engaging although it was sometimes a little hard to understand with her accent. Overall highly recommend the tour.
author: KERSTIN_F

title: Great intro to the city
text: Very interesting and informative walk with Lorena. Leant a lot about the history of the city as well as the old areas that the walk goes through. Great to experience the city as dusk falls. Plenty of hills for exercise but the pace was fine.
author: Hugh_L

title: Our tour guide was...
text: Our tour guide was incredibly knowledgeable and so easy to understand.  The tour was excellent, the best I have had in Spain so far.  We were able to take some wonderful photos of the sunset due to our guide being so patient with all of us.  He also made sure to position us in the best photographic spots.
author: Cath_M

title: A great experience
text: A wonderful experience. Our guide (sadly I don’t know how to spell her name) was enthusiastic and knowledgeable. She took us to places for amazing views, a truly great experience. A small issue with finding the precise meeting point, mentioning the fountain in the details would have helped.
author: jotM4449FV

title: Walk with Paola the Perfect, recommended!
text:
Paola was so informative and fun to be with. A lot of the times your guide would make or break your tour, she was very informative also toke enough breaks so her rhythm was perfect.
Definitely recommend taking the tour, we were second guessing our decision and about to be a no-show. Extremely happy that we did it!
author: danias751

title: Great way to see the Grenada vistas.
text:
Amazing sites and vistas! Our tour guide was amazing, funny and upbeat. We learned quite a bit. She was very tiny so she used her pink umbrella to keep us together.
Wonderful tour.
author: lisasmall63

title: A walk in Granada"s history and beautifull quarters
text: The best way to learn about the history of a town , you have to be in a bit of shape as it is a decent walk about. And the views are beautifull.
author: MarkvanVollenhoven

title: I highly recommend this...
text:
I highly recommend this tour! The timing and pacing were perfect. It takes you through the historic neighborhoods of Albaicín and Sacromonte, while stopping at stunning viewpoints along the way.

A huge thank you and shoutout to our guide, Lorena. She was incredibly passionate, knowledgeable, and well-versed in local history, architecture, and geography. You could ask her anything and always get an insightful answer.

author: X_Z
